title: 面向北极生态导航的自主GeoAI智能体系统
summary: 提出一种人在回路的多智能体GeoAI系统，用于北极生态导航。系统整合运营、物理、生态与社区多准则，通过多个专用智能体协同完成地理空间数据获取、多目标路径生成与天际线决策支持，显式考虑敏感生态区域与社区影响，在保留人类价值判断的前提下支持更安全、透明且负责任的北极航线规划。
summary_en: We introduce a human-in-the-loop, multi-agent GeoAI system for Arctic eco-navigation that integrates operational, physical, ecological, and community-related criteria within a unified routing framework. Multiple specialized agents coordinate geospatial data acquisition and preparation, multi-objective route generation, and skyline-based decision support. Ecological criteria explicitly account for exposure to sensitive areas such as Essential Fish Habitat and seal critical habitat, supporting safer, more transparent, and socially responsible Arctic navigation.
